title: Multimodal local-model live acceptance

context.summary: Add acceptance coverage for the supported local model profile across text, PDF OCR, image OCR/caption, audio ASR, video keyframes, face detection, search, source refs, jobs and audit logs.
context.background: TASK-123 wired local model Compose profiles and TASK-124 added installer auto-install. The supported deterministic local HTTP runner must now have a checked multimodal acceptance gate.

in: Add multimodal fixtures or fixture generation for local-model acceptance.
Add a local-model acceptance command that can run as dry-run in pnpm check and live when explicitly enabled.
Verify text, PDF OCR, image OCR/caption, audio ASR, video keyframe and face-detection paths through the local model profile.
Verify artifacts, source refs, jobs, model audit records and search results.
Document how to run the local-model acceptance gate.
out: Adding heavy third-party local model runner images.

acceptance_criteria: A `pnpm local-model:acceptance` command exists and is included in repository checks.
Default acceptance mode is deterministic and safe for CI; live Docker mode is enabled only by an explicit environment variable.
Live mode uses the supported local model profile and verifies multimodal processing artifacts for text, PDF, image, audio, video and faces.
The gate verifies source refs, job completion, search results and model operation audit records.
Docs describe the command, required Docker/local profile settings and expected outputs.
pnpm local-model:acceptance, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Live Docker mode remains opt-in and does not download heavy third-party model images in default CI.

risks: Full live multimodal checks depend on Docker and can take longer than default CI, so the default gate validates the flow shape and live mode is explicit.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
